item.title: 伙伴交付体系
item.summary: AI伙伴交付的控制权不在伙伴数量，而在生产责任账本。云/模型厂商应保留产品与模型版本、身份安全、数据与遥测、技术认证、生产发布、重大升级和伙伴质量评分；伙伴规模化行业发现、数据连接、客户配置、变更培训、地域落地和L1/L2运营。AWS、Google与Anthropic已经建立不同的认证、协议、co-sell和生产门槛，但跨玩家同cohort成本、失败、续约与贡献毛利未知，当前只判pilot。

synthesis.outlook_12_36m: 赢家会把伙伴体系从目录和认证升级为可观测的生产网络：同一客户cohort记录版本、测试、上线、故障、厂商升级、伙伴工时、客户依赖、结果、续约和扩张。厂商保留不可委托的控制面，伙伴获得行业与地域交付弹性。没有可比cohort经济与质量分布时不得升至scaling。
synthesis.strategic_summary: AI伙伴交付的控制权不在伙伴数量，而在生产责任账本。云/模型厂商应保留产品与模型版本、身份安全、数据与遥测、技术认证、生产发布、重大升级和伙伴质量评分；伙伴规模化行业发现、数据连接、客户配置、变更培训、地域落地和L1/L2运营。AWS、Google与Anthropic已经建立不同的认证、协议、co-sell和生产门槛，但跨玩家同cohort成本、失败、续约与贡献毛利未知，当前只判pilot。
synthesis.why_now: 企业AI瓶颈从模型可用转向生产集成、治理和变更。模型和云厂商正迅速扩张伙伴资金、认证与市场分发；同时pilot停滞、合同亏损和责任不清表明，若没有共同结果账本，外部化人力只会把成本和事故责任移出视野。
winner_conditions: 厂商拥有产品版本、身份安全、数据遥测、生产放行和重大升级权
伙伴以生产客户、质量、续约和客户结果分层，而非认证数量
委托的实施与运营字段完整回流共同结果账本
每个成功生产部署的完全成本和厂商升级负担随规模下降
客户依赖、变更、失败和责任边界可审计

evidence.source_quote: Both individuals and organizations that work with arXivLabs have embraced and accepted our values of openness, community, excellence, and user data privacy. arXiv is committed to these values and only works with partners that adhere to them.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: PACT shows that multilateral AI service quality includes subjective and objective dimensions, limiting clean delegation and outcome contracting.

evidence.source_quote: Title: Cloud Platforms for Developing Generative AI Solutions: A Scoping Review of Tools and Services
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: A peer-reviewed scoping review maps cloud generative-AI service layers and preserves vendor lock-in and technical limits as partner-delivery boundaries.

evidence.source_quote: Cost of professional services and other revenue (2) 70,063 57,272 203,072 162,628
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Snowflake discloses a partner-heavy implementation model and negative professional-services economics, limiting claims that externalization automatically improves total delivery margin.

evidence.source_quote: Since its launch in 2024 , we have invested over $115 million in the AWS AI Competency, demonstrating our commitment to accelerating successful customer AI adoption through Specialization Partners. These new categories reflect the rapid market advancement, helping customers find Partners who can move them from experimentation to production-ready autonomous systems:
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: AWS discloses investment, validation and successful-customer requirements for agentic AI consulting partners.

evidence.source_quote: Team members can use Amazon Q Developer for assistance with code generation, testing, and debugging. They can also get help with business questions, their code base, and other topics related to enterprise data. Using the service, DTCC engineers can transform and implement new code to meet their specific requests. During the POC, the company boosted developer throughput by 40 percent, accelerating product development by saving many hours a week. “During our POCs, we found that something that used to take 10 hours now takes 6 hours using Amazon Q Developer,” says Powell. “That is quite powerful.” The company also reduced code defects and the associated operational risks by 30 percent while improving test coverage during the POC. Throughout the use of Amazon Q Developer, build-failure rates did not increase.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: DTCC separates proof of concept from phased production and exposes measurable outcome evidence needed to qualify delivery claims.

evidence.source_quote: The AI opportunity for Google Cloud partners is growing fast. For example, a new study from IDC 1 found that global systems integrators will grow their Google Cloud AI practices as much as 100% this year — and almost half of their Google Cloud AI projects have already moved into widespread production thanks to initial ROI that customers are seeing. It’s clear that much of the opportunity ahead lies in agentic AI — and now, partners are infused at every layer of our AI agent stack.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Google separates the platform and protocols it controls from implementation, managed services and co-selling delegated to services partners.

evidence.source_quote: On the development side, the results were just as concrete. Tecban estimated a 30% productivity gain in development and 14% in testing, reinforcing GitHub Copilot's role as a technical accelerator within the broader strategy. The same momentum showed up in day-to-day activities: "An analysis that used to take 4 hours and 47 minutes is now done in 2 minutes and 35 seconds. In another case, it dropped from 1 hour and 35 minutes to 52 seconds," notes Fabio Viel dos Santos, Process Manager at Tecban.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Tecban provides measurable production adoption but insufficient partner-cost detail, which helps distinguish product success from partner unit economics.

evidence.source_quote: As a response to these asks, at the Startup Summit in October, we introduced a private preview of a Startup Track within our AWS Specialization Program beginning in Q1 2025 . This purpose-built track will support startups in achieving AWS Specialization to showcase expertise to customers and unlock benefits designed to help you go to market with AWS. Initially it will focus on AWS Specializations like Gen AI and Security. To help startups go-to-market faster with AWS, eligible Global Startup program Partners can take advantage of MDF to create three fully AWS funded co-branded joint marketing assets with our marketing agencies including eBooks, Workshops, Case Studies, Webinars.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: AWS describes partner-led channel incentives and specialization signals, but the disclosed comparison does not establish end-customer production quality.

evidence.source_quote: Over 1,400 Accenture engineers will be trained as specialists in using Anthropic’s models on AWS, allowing them to provide customers with end-to-end support that accelerates their AI strategies from concept to production. Accenture’s engineers will help organizations use their own data to fine-tune Anthropic’s models on AWS to enhance performance for their use case and industry. Teams across Accenture and AWS will also guide customers on prompt and platform engineering to help them deploy AI models through Amazon Bedrock and Amazon SageMaker.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: DC Health is a real three-party model-cloud-SI production case that makes the delivery responsibility boundary observable.

evidence.source_quote: As an element of our business strategy, in response to client requirements and pressures on IT budgets, we offer an increasing portion of our services on a fixed-price, fixed-timeframe basis, rather than on a time-and-materials basis. In fiscal 2025 and 2024, revenues from fixed-price, fixed-timeframe projects accounted for approximately 54% and 53% of our total revenue, respectively. In addition, pressure on the IT budgets of our clients has led us to deviate from our standard pricing policies and to offer varied pricing models to our clients in certain situations in order to remain competitive. For example, we enter into transaction-based pricing contracts with certain clients who were not historically offered such terms in order to give them the flexibility to pay as they use our services.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Infosys' audited filing provides a partner-delivery stress test: scope, estimation, client dependency and performance risk can make scaled contracts unprofitable.

evidence.source_quote: A significant proportion of our $100 million investment will go directly to our partners as direct support for training and sales enablement, and for market development (including work to make customer deployments successful) and co-marketing for joint campaigns and events. We’re also scaling our partner-facing team fivefold, so that we can provide dedicated Applied AI engineers to partners working on live customer deals, technical architects to scope more complex implementations, and localized go-to-market support in international markets.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Anthropic discloses which enablement, engineering and go-to-market functions it funds while external partners carry implementation capacity.

evidence.source_quote: Comments: Ojewale, V., Steed, R., Vecchione, B., Birhane, A., & Raji, I. D. (2025). Towards AI Accountability Infrastructure: Gaps and Opportunities in AI Audit Tooling. In CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI '25), April 26--May 01, 2025, Yokohama, Japan. ACM, New York, NY, USA, 29 pages
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Research on AI audit tooling identifies accountability gaps that cannot be solved by certifications or partner counts alone.

evidence.source_quote: In the same article, Borno cited a 2024 Gartner study that showed only 21 percent of AI proofs of concept convert to production. “That means 79 percent is just wasted work and, in a resource constrained world, that just makes no sense for anybody,” states Borno. “When we look at our Generative AI Competency Partners, they’re having conversion rates of 50, 70, 80 percent in some cases. Why? Because they have demonstrated impact already with other customers, and so they have a higher likelihood of having that success with additional customers.”
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: AWS reports a large conversion-rate gap between general AI proofs of concept and selected competency partners, a useful but vendor-attributed scale claim.

evidence.source_quote: One of the biggest barriers to enterprise AI adoption is unclear accountability: technology teams manage IT infrastructure , governance, security and vendor relationships; innovation teams run pilots; individual business units experiment independently; and senior executives communicate ambition and strategic direction. Yet in many organizations, nobody owns AI adoption from end to end.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Independent commentary identifies unclear internal accountability as a delivery failure mode that cannot be delegated away to a partner.

evidence.source_quote: In March, we launched the Claude Partner Network—a program, backed by a $100 million investment in partner training, technical support, and shared marketing, for the firms that help enterprises put Claude into production. Since then, more than 40,000 firms have applied to join and more than 10,000 consultants have earned a Claude certification—a credential, held by an individual, that signals they've been trained to build and deploy Claude in production.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Anthropic ties partner tiering to certifications, delivered production work and customer references, exposing a quality-control mechanism.

evidence.source_quote: Jabil’s collaboration with AWS has delivered impactful results. During its first EBA engagement, Jabil tackled a critical business challenge by automating manual processes for shop floor applications. Using tools such as AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) and Terraform, the company achieved a 67–83 percent reduction in deployment times and a 74 percent decrease in data processing times. These advancements helped Jabil scale operations horizontally, onboard additional sites without performance degradation, and accelerate the global adoption of AWS services.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Jabil shows a cloud-led expert engagement expanding into repeatable site deployment, while customer-specific integration remains material.

evidence.source_quote: Reprice services, because they can do more work at lower cost. This is the short-term effect. Service providers have been through this before in the transition to offshore labor arbitrage and cloud computing. They will do it again, automating more work, establishing deeper co-innovation with alliance partners, and building more assets to improve services and outcomes. They will alter their staffing structures, invest more in platforms, and change their pricing and risk models, including more value-based and shared-risk commercial models. They will also charge explicitly for or bundle in the cost of their assets as part of the new commercial value proposition.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Forrester frames the shift from labor scale to platform assets and shared risk, relevant to what a cloud vendor should retain versus delegate.

evidence.source_quote: As part of the scheme, the duo will provide firms with a suite of six industry-specific agentic AI solutions designed to help push projects from pilot to production.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Independent media records pilot stalling and the packaged Google-Accenture response, preserving the gap between partner supply and production outcomes.
